subject: Physics
questionText: Which of the following best describes a force?
options: A push or pull acting on an object
The speed of a moving object
correctAnswer: A push or pull acting on an object
explanation: A force is a push or pull that can change the motion, shape, or state of an object.

subject: Physics
questionText: What is the SI unit of force?
explanation: Force is measured in Newtons (N), named after Sir Isaac Newton.

subject: Physics
questionText: An object is moving at constant speed in a straight line. What can you conclude about the forces acting on it?
options: There is no force acting on it
explanation: When an object moves at constant speed in a straight line, the resultant force is zero — the forces are balanced.

subject: Physics
questionText: What is the difference between mass and weight?
options: Mass is the amount of matter; weight is the gravitational force on that mass
Mass and weight are the same thing
Weight is the amount of matter; mass is the gravitational force
Mass is measured in Newtons; weight is measured in kilograms
correctAnswer: Mass is the amount of matter; weight is the gravitational force on that mass
explanation: Mass (kg) measures the amount of matter. Weight (N) is the gravitational force acting on that mass.

subject: Physics
questionText: Which force always opposes the motion of objects moving through air?
explanation: Air resistance, also called drag, acts opposite to the direction of motion when an object moves through air.

subject: Physics
questionText: A book rests on a table. Which pair of forces are action-reaction pairs?
options: Weight of book downward and normal force of table upward on book
Weight of book and weight of table
Normal force on book and friction
correctAnswer: Weight of book downward and normal force of table upward on book
explanation: The normal force from the table acts upward on the book, balancing the downward weight of the book.

subject: Physics
options: Change in velocity per unit time
explanation: Speed = distance ÷ time. It is a scalar quantity (no direction).

subject: Physics
questionText: A car travels 120 km in 2 hours. What is its average speed?
explanation: Average speed = total distance ÷ total time = 120 km ÷ 2 h = 60 km/h.

subject: Physics
questionText: When the resultant force on an object is NOT zero, the object will:
explanation: A non-zero resultant force causes acceleration — the object speeds up, slows down, or changes direction.

subject: Physics
options: Opposes relative motion between surfaces in contact
Only acts on objects in liquids
Acts only when objects are stationary
correctAnswer: Opposes relative motion between surfaces in contact
explanation: Friction acts between surfaces in contact and opposes the relative sliding motion between them.
